title: Intrinsic-Dimensional Wasserstein Guarantees for Private Synthetic Measures
summary: We study an $\varepsilon$-differentially private synthetic measure for $n$ points in $[0,1]^d$ by applying the existing PrivTree algorithm to construct an adaptive binary partition and then privately releasing its leaf masses. We consider the worst-case data model without any sampling or population-distribution assumption. The 1-Wasserstein error of the synthetic measure is $\widetilde O_d((\varepsilon n)^{-1/d})$ for $d\ge2$, which is optimal compared to the minimax lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.
